title: Pro & con analysis

body.text: For hard decisions, let the AI bring order:
lay out the pros and cons of each option, with criteria for comparison
— give it the context and constraints (budget, time, team) so the analysis fits your situation, not a generic textbook.

example: "Compare 'hire an agency' vs 'build our own team' for marketing, budget 100k/month, need results in 6 months, team is currently 2 people"

title: Have the AI argue against itself

body.text: ask for a devil's advocate — have the AI argue against the option you're leaning toward
— we all have biases, so having the AI find the weaknesses of your favorite option genuinely helps you decide more carefully.

example: "I'm leaning toward hiring an agency — play devil's advocate and give the best reasons why we shouldn't"

question: What must you tell the AI for a good pro & con analysis?

options.text: Our real context and constraints, like budget, time, team
The answer you want to get
Having the AI argue against the option you're leaning toward
Having the AI agree with everything

question: Why is it useful to have the AI argue against your favorite option?

options.text: It reduces your own bias and helps you decide more carefully

question: To decide an important matter from all angles, what should you ask for?

options.text: Ask for the single most correct answer
Ask it to predict the future
Ask for a pro & con, and have the AI argue against itself

question: How does having the AI argue against itself help?
